normalization_rules: Do not equate Arc native USDC gas balance (18 decimals) with the USDC ERC-20 interface (6 decimals) without mapping both representations to the same underlying asset and preventing double counting.
Record provider, endpoint, node/client version, capture timestamp, block number/hash or XRPL ledger index/hash, query parameters, pagination marker, raw response hash and stated archival coverage.
Treat Nodely's 33-hour retention as unsuitable for long historical backtesting; use an indexed/archive provider for older history and independently reconcile samples against a node.
Treat Bitquery's 2026-09-16 availability statement as a dated provider claim, not proof that all archival datasets work on 2026-11-02.
Use exponential backoff and bounded retries for provider rate limits; never fill gaps with interpolated transaction events.
For XRPL attacker/recipient account reconciliation, pin the same validated ledger index/hash across account_info/account_tx requests and paginate account_tx using the returned marker.
Do not count Arc native USDC and its ERC-20 interface as two separate supplies or transfer flows.
